La Story des Échos est le podcast économ: La Story des Échos is the daily business podcast of the newspaper Les Échos. In a few minutes, it breaks down a piece of economic news in narrative form. An ambitious format that tries to make finance and economics accessible without sacrificing journalistic precision.
Le podcast d'actualité économique du jou: The business news podcast from Les Échos, presented by Pierrick Fay. Each episode analyses a news topic in depth — startups, real estate, geopolitics — with rigour and clarity. The music creates a real sound identity, the voice makes listening lively, and the journalists deliver solid analysis without pointless buzz. Our verdict: 9/10 without hesitation. Professional, intelligent, pleasant to listen to — and it helps you understand the world without drowning in the news flow.
